Welcome to the Sport Medicine Athletic Trainer YouTube Page! Here you can find information and how-to's on all things Sports Medicine. This channel offers something for Athletic Trainers, Physical Therapists, and any and all who might be on a sideline or in a clinic assisting athletes to meet their goals. For more information on the Sports Medicine Program, please visit www.northwell.edu/sport 

Please subscribe and share this channel!! 

To make an appointment with one of our Sports Specialists call 833-9-SPORTS or email SPORTS@northwell.edu

Check out our Instagram https://www.instagram.com/sportsmed_atc/    

Also, check out our previous YT page ‪ @sports_atc6569
